idea: A massive, tightly stacked serif carries the cover; one orange sun is the only image.
name: The Grid

idea: The author's name is the biggest thing on the cover, like an established bestseller; hard black-and-white photo.
name: Brand Name

idea: The photo is cropped to a thin horizon strip across the middle; the rest is quiet paper and a calm serif.
name: Horizon Band
Up the Spine
idea: The title runs vertically up the left edge in towering condensed caps; a narrow right column holds a red square and the author.

name: Arch Window
idea: A duotone portrait seen through a chapel-window arch with a hairline frame; an italic serif title sits below like a caption.

name: Color Field
idea: Two soft-edged painted fields stack like an abstract canvas; the title is set small and wide on the bare margin below.

name: The Band
idea: A solid band of deep color slices across a toned landscape and carries the title in reversed Bodoni.
A single red thread drops from the top edge to a tiny knot, and the title hangs from it in open space.
name: The Thread

idea: The title is struck once in full ink, then repeats down the cover in ever fainter impressions, like a sound dying away.
name: Echo
Sliver
idea: The portrait survives only as a narrow vertical slice; a tall stacked Caslon title holds the open left side.
A small bordered family print lies on linen like a photo found in a drawer; a long italic title reads as its caption.
name: Snapshot
Close
idea: A full-bleed black-and-white face fills the cover; the title is one quiet serif line at its foot, with a single spot of color above it.
A sepia photograph fills the top half and a clean page the bottom, split by a single line of color, like an album leaf.
name: Top Half

idea: The portrait is cropped to a letterbox of the eyes alone, a gaze held between title and author.
name: Eyes

idea: A lowercase italic title rests at the optical center of warm paper, with one short hairline and nothing else: a whisper of a cover.
name: Quiet
Typewritten
idea: The cover is a typed manuscript page with a red margin line; the title sits where the first lines would be.

name: Locket
idea: A small oval portrait ringed in a gold hairline sits high on a deep ground, kept like a locket; classical capitals below.

name: Say It Loud
idea: A voice-driven memoir: the heavy serif title shouts across a saturated ground, and the author's name is stamped in a black band.

name: One Word
idea: A big-idea book sold on one word: the title runs edge to edge in condensed black caps on a loud, flat ground.

name: Rising Line
idea: One bold band of color climbs across the cover like a growth chart; heavy sans title stacked hard to the top left.
A hard black-and-white face is split down the middle by a solid column of color that carries the title: two selves, one cover.
name: Divided Mind
Deep Field
idea: The universe runs full bleed and a wide display title floats in its darkest sky, like a narrative science bestseller.
The image hangs in a hairline frame like an archive print, with engraved capitals above and an italic caption below.
name: Museum Plate

idea: A field of survey contour lines with one small summit marker; the title is cut into a solid block like an expedition stamp.
name: Contour
The Card
idea: A self-help promise set huge and stacked on a white card, laid on a cheerful flat ground like a note to yourself.

name: Dawn
idea: A half sun rises from the bottom edge into a soft morning gradient, beneath a calm lowercase serif title.
A calm landscape runs full bleed and the title sits on a plain paper card pinned to its lower left, like a note left on the view.
name: Field Note
Redacted
idea: A classified page where every line is blacked out except the title, with a red stamp struck across the bars.
The city glows through the mullions of a high-rise window; the title sits on the dark sill beneath.
name: Window Grid

idea: The photo is cut down to a single letterbox band across a dark field, like a view through a mail slot.
name: The Slit

idea: The title is set vertically up the left edge like a spine; the photo fills the rest behind one hard accent cut.
name: Spine Line
Echo
idea: The title repeats down the cover like an echo, fading in and out; only the middle line burns in full color.

name: The Cut
idea: A slab of hazard color slices diagonally across a black-and-white photo; the title rides the cut.
The stacked title is set so big it bleeds off the right edge of the cover; one accent bar is the only other mark.
name: Hard Border
Surveillance
idea: The photo is framed as a CCTV feed: viewfinder brackets, a red recording dot, and the title as the evidence beneath.
A golden-age detective cover: warm light pours through a single keyhole in a dark lacquered door.
name: Keyhole
Deco Arch
idea: A 1930s travel-poster arch frames a sepia photograph, as if the murder happened on holiday.

name: One Lit Window
idea: Domestic suspense: a black house against a dusk sky, and only one window is awake.
Domestic suspense: a washed-out portrait and a calm serif title, with one red underline as the only wrong note.
name: Pale Portrait

idea: Noir: hard light falls through venetian blinds across a black-and-white photo; one lipstick-red name.
name: Venetian Blinds

idea: Noir: a single streetlamp throws a cone of light into the dark, and the title stands inside it.
name: Under the Lamp

idea: A golden-age country-house mystery: a fine-line floor plan of the rooms, and a red X where the body lies.
name: Floor Plan
White Horizon
idea: Nordic mystery: a cold photo whose highlights melt into a snow-white field, with one tiny red figure on the horizon.

name: Ajar
idea: A door stands open a crack in total darkness; the photo shows only through that sliver of light.

name: Unblinking
idea: Two small eyes open in a vast, empty black; the restraint is the scare.

name: Black Sun
idea: Folk horror: a midsummer eclipse, one black disc ringed in red on a bone-pale ground.

name: Her Likeness
idea: A haunted portrait drowned in a single color; the title is a small italic whisper beneath it.

name: The Drip
idea: Visceral with restraint: one thin red drip runs from the black title down an otherwise clean white cover.

name: The Still Lake
idea: The title sits on a black waterline, and its reflection hangs upside down beneath it, wrong in a way you notice slowly.

name: Claw Marks
idea: Three clean cuts tear diagonally through a huge title like claw marks; violence implied, never shown.
One old snapshot hangs alone on a stained wall, with a handwritten caption no one should have written.
name: Found Photograph
Blade & Ring
idea: A slender blade pierces a thin gold ring: love and violence in one romantasy emblem, floating in smoke.

name: Ember Arch
idea: A duotone portrait glows through a tall arch window, its edge echoed by a hairline of gold, like a fae court's doorway.
Two flat circles drift into each other; where they overlap a third color appears, which is the whole rom-com in one diagram.
name: Venn
Postcard
idea: The photo is a holiday postcard with rounded corners and a stamped postmark ring; a chunky soft serif title sits above like handwriting on the back.

name: Cameo
idea: A portrait set like a Regency cameo: an oval crop in a hairline gold ring, with a swooning italic title beneath.
A painted portrait fills the top two-thirds; a solid band of jewel-toned silk, edged with a gold trim line, carries the type like a gown's hem.
name: Silk Hem

idea: A single blood-red hairline slices diagonally across a stacked high-contrast serif title on near-black; nothing else.
name: Slash
Slit
idea: The photo is only glimpsed through a narrow vertical slit in black, like a door left ajar; the title is laid across it in white.

name: Wildflower Wash
idea: A loose wet-in-wet wash of field colors blooms over the top half and fades into cream paper, where a soft serif title waits.
A striped shop awning with a scalloped edge crowns the cover, so the whole book becomes the shopfront; a warm soft serif title stacks below.
name: Awning

idea: A round lens and a stout handle turn the photo into a view through a detective's magnifying glass, set on a quiet flat ground.
name: Magnifier
Jam Label
idea: The cover is a jar of preserves: a cream oval label with a fine inner line sits on gingham, and the title is lettered on it like a homemade label.
Split like a seed packet: a tall rounded panel of garden painting on the right, the title stacked down a quiet cream column on the left.
name: Garden Panel
Hearth
idea: A hearth arch drawn in one warm line holds a tiny two-tone flame, its glow and a few drifting sparks the only light on a dark ground.

name: Framed Print
idea: A landscape in a soft two-color duotone is matted and hairline-framed like a print hung in a cottage, the title lettered on the mat above.
A crescent moon is cut from two overlapping circles above a soft, lowercase title, like a witch's shop sign at dusk.
name: Crescent
Hanging Sign
idea: The title is painted on a cream shop sign hung by two chains against dark wood, with the author on a smaller sign swinging beneath it.
A photo flooded with one neon duotone; the title is set so large it bleeds off both edges of the cover.
name: Bleed
Orbit
idea: A huge circle of deep space is punched out of a loud flat color and circled by a single tilted orbit line; lowercase title below.

name: Echo
idea: The title is set three times down the cover, fading up from a whisper to full volume, a typographic crescendo.

name: Tilt
idea: A tilted slab of flat color slices across a duotone photo, and the title rides its eight-degree angle, off balance and urgent.

name: Polaroid
idea: One instant photo taped to a flat color wall, with the title scrawled in marker across its bottom edge as if someone wrote on it.
A flat red moon rises behind one razor-sharp mountain silhouette; vast dark space, and a carved title on the ground below.
name: Blood Moon

idea: The photo is cut down to a thin eye-line band across black, like a redacted file, with a towering condensed title below.
name: Sliver
Horizon
idea: A sunset gradient, a flat sun half-sunk below a hard horizon line, and three fading reflections on the water; the title hangs in the sky.

name: Sword in the Ring
idea: A single gold emblem, a blade driven through a ring, glows in the dark like a sigil stamped on a war banner.

name: Atlas Plate
idea: A vellum band sits over the painted land like the title plate of an old atlas, split from the world by one hard line.

name: The Gate
idea: The world is glimpsed through a single gold-lined arch, a doorway the reader is invited to step through.
The heroine looks out of an enchanted hand mirror, the whole cover drawn as a single object on a pale ground.
name: Hand Mirror

idea: A fairytale forest cut from two layers of paper triangles, with one red moon caught in the branches.
name: Cut-Paper Wood
Library Binding
idea: A cloth-bound book with a tiny gilt key at its center: the smallest object promising the largest secret.
Only the eyes survive: the portrait is cut to a blood-washed slit across a black cover.
name: The Slit
Blood Diamond
idea: A blackletter title sealed inside a red lozenge, like a warning painted on a plague door.

name: Eclipse
idea: A black sun ringed by a hairline corona hangs over a darkened land; nothing else is needed.
The cover is a scientific figure: hairline orbits around a star, and one red world the story happens on.
name: Orbital Diagram

idea: Half the cover is pure vacuum; the other half is the curve of a world, with wide type floating in the silence between.
name: Planet Limb
Carrier Wave
idea: A single signal pulses up from the bottom edge in fading rings toward a giant condensed title.

name: Rank Insignia
idea: Three gold chevrons, the rank stripes of a fleet, stand alone against the galaxy like a uniform patch.
A hard duotone portrait is cut off at the chest by a slab of signal color, and the title is printed straight onto the slab.
name: Signal Block
Ringed Crescent
idea: A planet too big for the cover rises in the dark, lit on one thin edge and crossed by the hairline of its ring.
The title is printed twice, a hair out of register, so the near future feels like a signal that won't quite hold still.
name: Misregistered
Lit Screen
idea: One small glowing screen in a vast quiet field: the only face left is the one inside the device.

name: Censored Print
idea: A sepia photograph mounted on worn paper, cleared for release by a crooked red censor's stamp.
Two pale searchlight beams cross over a blacked-out city, sweeping straight through a towering title.
name: Searchlights

idea: A striped medal ribbon runs the full height, dividing a stacked title column from a soldier's quiet face.
name: Ribbon

idea: A black arched window set into a gilded sunburst, the title glowing inside it like a ballroom marquee.
name: Deco Window
Sealing Wax
idea: The cover is a private letter: an italic title written on cream paper, closed with one red wax seal.

name: Gallery Plaque
idea: The heroine hangs in a gilt frame like a museum portrait, named on a small engraved plaque.
One enormous word spans the sky like a carved lintel over generations of land; a deep band below carries the family name.
name: Saga Lintel
The Crossing
idea: A pale sky over a deep sea with one tiny ship on the horizon: a generation's voyage reduced to a single line.
